Island_169.terrain_character: A dark, wet frontier of broken woods, boggy lowlands, old roads, flooded hollows, misty channels, ruins, and stretches of more solid upland that can hold abandoned forts, graveyards, and isolated settlements.
Island_169.settlement_role: Sparse frontier villages, old fortified crossings, marsh hamlets, ruined estates, and isolated communities separated by difficult terrain and remnants of older roads.
Island_169.primary_function: Old frontier and haunted wetland region
Island_169.secondary_feature: Dark forests, peat bogs, blackwater channels, flooded ruins, battlefields, graveyards, abandoned roads
Island_169.travel_role: A difficult edge-region reached by a few old roads and crossings; travel should feel uncertain, indirect, and increasingly isolated away from the main approaches.
Island_169.lore_notes: This region reads as a former borderland where settlement, conflict, flooding, and abandonment layered over one another. The former Blackfen character survives inside it as its wettest, most drowned terrain rather than as a separate map region.
